modules.module_title: Take charge of shift from jute carding operator

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 15 minutes earlier to the work spot
check the availability of Piled Jute/ Spreader roll for feeding to Jute Carding machine
ensure the availability of the operational tools like knife, Knife sharpener, picking hook, broom etc. nearby the machine
interact with the previous shift jute carding operator and take information regarding the quality of jute to be fed,/run (as recommended for the yarn quality to spin)
ensure the availability of the recommended variety (grade) of piled jute/spreader roll/sliver as per quality of the Jute Yarn to make
ensure cleanliness of the surrounding area as well as the department (particularly beneath the machine)
ensure that the cut roots of Jute strand (reed) are kept/stored in the proper place
check the colour coding of different quality of Jute sliver rolls, as per quality & grade of raw jute (TD3-TD7 or W3-W7), or the display board (mentioned the jute grade) in case of piled jute
ensure running status of the carding machine while taking charge, with correct draft change pinion (written in board)
patrol around the carding department to trace out and remove any undesirable material lying on the floor
check that the roll former in 1st card (Breaker card) is in proper working condition, and need no maintenance

modules.module_title: Hand over shift to next jute carding operator

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the machines are in running condition before handing it over to the next shift
convey your counterpart regarding any maintenance work to be carried out in the next shift in case of necessity
inform the incoming carding operator about quality, colour code, piled jute stock, machine parameter etc., and mechanical problems ( if any, and cannot be done due to lack of time)
ensure uniform and regular delivery of fleece of jute sliver from the doffer on the conductor (delivery side without any interruption
all types of wastages like droppings below the machine, sliver wastages, fleece to be collected, weighed and sent to the back for reprocess
ensure the handover of clean and running machine as well as the clean surroundings
any delayed arrival of the counterpart to be reported to supervisors

pcs.pc_description: ensure that starting/stopping/control switches are O.K. in case individual drive and alternative arrangements in case of group drive

pcs.pc_description: ensure proper working of delivery roll, and roll former (no jamming)
open the cover of the doffing zone of card and clean the doffer periodically for ensuring proper jute sliver delivery
don't allow slivers to accumulate in delivery conducting plate
collect the waste from shrouding plate zone

ensure the carded jute sliver passes through the delivery conducting plate and/or conveyor/ rollers and to pass it through the conductor/ conveyor/ rollers (as the case may be) to the delivery zone for formation of condensed sliver roll to pass to roll former
ensure proper functioning of roll former and ensure time and diameter setting of roll turner as instructed
collect the wastes produced in the roll former zone and store the waste at respective waste box
ensure uniformity of the sliver otherwise report the Superior (sardar/ superior)

ensure that sliver tension in the delivery and roll former section is appropriate
collect the full jute sliver rolls with proper colour code for feed in the finisher card
keep the roll storage area of roll former clean before doffing of the carded sliver rolls (quality wise stacking)
keep the breaker card sliver rolls near the finisher card for feeding them in the finisher card in next stage
ensure tight packing of the rolls; if not, report to maintenance department for collecting the same
ensure that there is no worn out parts in the doffing zone/misalignment in delivery and delivery press rolls
ensure proper material handling for moving jute sliver rolls using iron hooks
ensure proper picking of all the rollers periodically as instructed
